title: Support Selection Beyond Smooth DAG Exactness: Completion Geometry,Score Margins, and Selective Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2608.08103v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Smooth acyclicity constraints answer whether a weighted support is a DAG, whereas structure learning asks which support change should be made. Existing analyses establish degeneracy for particular constraint formulas but do not isolate what follows from smooth exactness itself. At a DAG boundary, we show that minimal cycle completions generate a squarefree monomial ideal containing every restricted Taylor jet of an exact representation. If the smallest completion has $q$ edges, the first possible response has order $q$ for a vector residual and $2q$ for a nonnegative scalar. Exponentially many constant-scale cyclic manifolds exhibit the same lack of ranking away from the boundary for NOTEARS and DAGMA. We derive the exact selection time for an isolated cycle. When $\Psi'(h)\asymp h^\nu$, the feasibility-only time is $T_0(\varepsilon)=\Theta(\varepsilon^{-(2\nu+1)})$; a score margin changes the leading dynamics at scale $T_0^{-1}$ for

translated_title: 超越平滑DAG精确性的支撑集选择：补全几何、分数边际与选择性证书
translated_abstract: 平滑无环性约束回答的是加权支撑集是否为有向无环图（DAG），而结构学习问的则是应当做出哪种支撑集的改变。现有分析仅针对特定约束公式建立了退化性，但并未分离出平滑精确性本身所能推出的结论。在DAG边界处，我们证明最小环补全生成一个无平方因子的单项式理想，该理想包含精确表示的所有受限泰勒喷射。若最小补全含有 $q$ 条边，则对于向量残差，首个可能的响应为 $q$ 阶；对于非负标量则为 $2q$ 阶。对于NOTEARS和DAGMA，指数多个常数尺度的循环流形在远离边界处表现出同样的排序缺失。我们推导了孤立环的精确选择时间：当 $\Psi'(h)\asymp h^\nu$ 时，仅可行性时间为 $T_0(\varepsilon)=\Theta(\varepsilon^{-(2\nu+1)})$；而分数边际在 $T_0^{-1}$ 的尺度上改变了主导动力学……
tldr: 该论文从最小环补全生成的单项式理想几何出发，刻画了平滑DAG精确性在边界处的退化机制，证明NOTEARS与DAGMA在远离边界处缺乏排序能力，并推导出孤立环的精确选择时间及分数边际对主导动力学的改变。
en_tdlr: The paper characterizes degeneracy at DAG boundaries via a squarefree monomial ideal generated by minimal cycle completions, shows that exponentially many constant-scale cyclic manifolds lack ranking for NOTEARS and DAGMA away from the boundary, and derives exact selection times for an isolated cycle with score margins altering the leading dynamics.
